Srivastava, App

02/05th June 2025 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioners have moved before this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail from
apprehending his arrest in connection with Untari Road P.S. Case No. 40 of 2022 instituted under
Sections 149, 323, 379, 380, 384, 420, 354, 120B, 307, 467, 504, 506 and 511 of the Indian Penal
Code.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have falsely been implicated in this case.
The allegation against these petitioners for cheating and fraud, are completely baseless and a concocted story.
He further submits that the allegations against these petitioners for assaulting and snatching money from the informant is totally false and the petitioner has committed no offence.
Therefore, the petitioners may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer of the petitioners for grant of bail.
5. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of this case, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to these petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrender,
they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing ( 2025:JHHC:14554 ) bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rs.
Twenty Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M.F.C., Palamau, in connection with Untari Road P.S. Case No. 40 of 2022.
6. It is made clear that petitioners shall co-operate with the investigation / trial.
If the petitioners will not co
- operate with the investigation / trial, the State would be at liberty to take appropriate action.
